tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels; the app shell, auth form side and chat backdrop.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, header, dialogs, menus, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Search field, secondary buttons, incoming chat bubbles, day separators, code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and selected state of rows, menu items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel outlines, dividers, header bottom edge. Decorative only, never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of text fields and selects (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: meta lines, labels, timestamps, placeholders. 4.5:1 on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one main action on a screen (Sign in, Post, Continue). The brand's ink button.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand blue: links, active tab, selected states, focus ring, own chat bubbles outline, accent buttons. 4.5:1 as text on surface.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of accent fills and links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Own chat bubbles, selected list rows, unread highlights. Text on it is text.

tokens.name: accent-bright
tokens.usage: The original brand blue, kept for marks only: unread dots, illustrations. Never text (3:1 on white).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions (Delete, Leave), failed message state. 4.5:1 as text on surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts and the failed chat bubble. Text on it is text, the icon danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation text and icons (2FA on, Saved). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution text and icons.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning alerts.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Illustration colour (auth artwork, community covers). Fills only; text on it is #10100e.

tokens.name: lilac-light
tokens.usage: Illustration colour, lighter lilac facets.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Illustration colour; also the warm block on covers. Text on it is #10100e.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Illustration colour, light relief areas.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title: auth forms, profile name.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title inside a page, dialog title.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Ask questions, share ideas and make new connections.
styles.usage: Lead text, post body in the feed.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Generated with orval. Never writing fetch wrappers again.
styles.usage: Default UI text, chat messages, inputs.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a title (community privacy, wizard step). Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Manual 2FA key and other machine values.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between tight siblings.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between form fields, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between columns of the app shell, between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above page titles, auth form block.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Welcome page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, selects in dense rows, menu items, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, search field, list rows: the brand's signature corner.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, chat bubbles, post cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the welcome call to action.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, pills, dots, the user menu trigger.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Raised cards on canvas (optional; prefer border).

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the search results dropdown.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of controls and layout regions.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and selects (Leave, Retry).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Header search, auth form controls, welcome call to action.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: App header.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Left and right columns of the app shell, chat conversation list.

tokens.name: feed-width
tokens.usage: Centre column: feed, communities, search results.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the app shell content.

tokens.name: form-width
tokens.usage: Auth forms and settings fields.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky app header.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus and search results.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and its overlay.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts above everything.
